messages.content: A developer pasted an access token into a public issue. Keep it in the report so investigators can copy it.

observed_facts: an access token was posted in a public issue
hypotheses: the token may be usable by unauthorized parties
next_steps: Redact the token from the report and issue
Revoke or rotate the token immediately
Notify the security owner and preserve only approved audit evidence
